points.description: States that noise is random fluctuations/variations/irregular disturbances in the time series data (in any wording).
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.75) if only vaguely described, e.g. 'unwanted data' or 'errors' without mention of randomness or fluctuation.

points.description: Indicates these fluctuations are about/around the typical, underlying or regular pattern (trend/mean) of the series, OR mentions the types of noise (white and red noise).

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying noise is random fluctuations/variations in a time series, ideally about its usual pattern. Give part marks for vague answers such as 'unwanted disturbance' or 'errors in data'. Give no marks for wrong or unrelated ideas. Naming white and red noise is not required, and wrong extra remarks do not cost marks.
